label: Glass & transparency
description: One glass for every Bifrost surface: the bar, dock, menus, launcher, control center, notifications, OSD and Settings. Application windows are not affected.

settings.label: Transparency
settings.description: 0 % = solid, 100 % = fully clear (only the border and blur remain). Standard = the theme's glass, tuned per surface and for light and dark

settings.label: Background blur
settings.description: Blurs what is behind the glass. 0 = off

settings.label: Tint (light mode)
settings.description: Colour of the glass in light mode. Empty = the theme's colour

settings.label: Tint (dark mode)
settings.description: Colour of the glass in dark mode. Empty = the theme's colour

settings.label: Border
settings.description: A thin outline around the glass
